Metadata.title: Influate — partnerships for growing creators and brands
Metadata.description: Creators get discovered by brands in their niche. Brands find the right voices, connect, and track what every affiliate code earns.

Footer.tagline: © Influate · Partnerships for growing creators and brands

Home.badge: A marketplace for growing creators and the brands that fit them
Home.title: Find partners who fit.
Home.intro: Creators build a profile and get discovered by companies in their niche. Brands find the right voices, connect, and see what every affiliate code brings in — away from the noise of your feeds.
Home.freeNote: Free to join. Contacts are shared only when both sides accept.
Home.howTitle: From profile to partnership in four steps
Home.step1Text: Creators add platforms, niche and audience. Brands add industry and who they want to reach.
Home.step2Text: Browse by category, audience and platform. Send a connect request with a short note.
Home.step3Text: Contact details unlock only when both sides accept. No cold DMs, no spam.
Home.step4Text: Log the affiliate code and the results it brings, and see earnings on your dashboard.
Home.forCreators1: Get found by brands in your niche, even with a small audience
Home.forCreators2: Keep all your affiliate codes and earnings in one place
Home.forCreators3: Decide who sees your contact details
Home.forBrands1: Filter creators by category, audience age and platform
Home.forBrands2: See revenue per creator and per code
Home.forBrands3: Tell creators what you sell and who you want to reach
Home.ctaTitle: Your next partnership is one profile away.

Hero.aria: Creators connect to brands and affiliate codes travel between them
